verdict.rationale: Harbor Compliance publishes a public, keyless OpenAPI v3 document. A probe confirms registered-agent-deliveries endpoints. The API uses OAuth client-credentials auth and documents rate limiting and idempotency keys. However, the evidence does not explicitly name entity-record or registered-agent-appointment endpoints, and create/update/delete operations need capabilities Harbor must explicitly grant. That makes programmatic management gated rather than self-serve. Missing for 10: explicit entity-record and RA-appointment endpoints in evidence, self-serve write access, independent or hands-on corroboration of reading and managing these records.
